symptom: PC gets an IP address but cannot reach the server.
topology_notes: PC1 is connected to Switch1 on Fa0/10 and should belong to VLAN 10.
show_commands_output:
show vlan brief
VLAN 10: Fa0/1, Fa0/2
VLAN 20: Fa0/10
known_correct_answer: Wrong VLAN assigned to the switch port.

symptom: PC receives a DHCP configuration but cannot communicate outside its LAN.
topology_notes: Router1 provides DHCP for the 192.168.10.0/24 LAN.
show_commands_output:
show ip dhcp pool
Network: 192.168.10.0/24
Default gateway: 192.168.20.1
known_correct_answer: DHCP pool has an incorrect default gateway.

symptom: PC can reach its gateway but cannot reach the remote network.
topology_notes: Router1 must reach the remote 192.168.30.0/24 network through Router2.
show_commands_output:
show ip route
C 192.168.10.0/24 is directly connected
No route for 192.168.30.0/24
known_correct_answer: Required route to the remote network is missing.

symptom: PC cannot communicate with the router.
topology_notes: PC1 connects directly to Router1 GigabitEthernet0/0.
show_commands_output:
show ip interface brief
GigabitEthernet0/0 192.168.10.1 administratively down down
known_correct_answer: Router interface is administratively down.

symptom: PC has an IP address but cannot communicate outside its local network.
topology_notes: PC1 uses Router1 as its default gateway.
show_commands_output:
PC IP: 192.168.10.20
Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway: 192.168.20.1
known_correct_answer: Default gateway is outside the PC subnet.

symptom: Devices cannot communicate because the required VLAN is not present on the switch.
topology_notes: PC1 should connect to VLAN 30.
show_commands_output:
show vlan brief
VLAN 10: Fa0/1, Fa0/2
VLAN 20: Fa0/3, Fa0/4
VLAN 30: not present
known_correct_answer: Required VLAN is missing from the switch.

symptom: A trunk link is not carrying VLAN traffic between switches.
topology_notes: Fa0/24 connects Switch1 and Switch2 and should operate as a trunk.
show_commands_output:
show interfaces fa0/24 switchport
Administrative Mode: static access
Operational Mode: static access
known_correct_answer: The switch-to-switch port is configured as an access port instead of a trunk.

symptom: Only some VLANs can communicate across the trunk.
topology_notes: The trunk should allow VLANs 10, 20 and 30.
show_commands_output:
show interfaces trunk
Port Fa0/24
Allowed VLANs: 10,20
known_correct_answer: VLAN 30 is missing from the trunk allowed VLAN list.

symptom: Devices on a trunk are placed into the wrong VLAN.
topology_notes: The network uses VLAN 99 as the native VLAN.
show_commands_output:
show interfaces trunk
Port Fa0/24
Native VLAN: 1
known_correct_answer: Native VLAN mismatch.

symptom: PC receives an address from the wrong network.
topology_notes: The LAN should use the 192.168.10.0/24 network.
show_commands_output:
show ip dhcp pool
Network: 192.168.20.0/24
known_correct_answer: DHCP pool is configured for the wrong network.

symptom: Clients cannot obtain IP addresses from DHCP.
topology_notes: Router1 should provide DHCP for the LAN.
show_commands_output:
show ip dhcp pool
No DHCP pools configured
known_correct_answer: DHCP pool is missing.

symptom: DHCP clients receive addresses that should be reserved for infrastructure.
topology_notes: Addresses 192.168.10.1 through 192.168.10.10 must be excluded.
show_commands_output:
show running-config | include excluded-address
ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.10.1 192.168.10.5
known_correct_answer: DHCP excluded-address range is incomplete.

symptom: PC cannot obtain an IP address from the DHCP server.
topology_notes: DHCP server is located at 192.168.10.5.
show_commands_output:
show ip interface brief
GigabitEthernet0/0 192.168.10.1 up up
ping 192.168.10.5
Destination host unreachable
known_correct_answer: DHCP server is unreachable.

symptom: Traffic to the remote network is sent to the wrong router.
topology_notes: Remote traffic should use next hop 10.0.0.2.
known_correct_answer: Static route has an incorrect next hop.

symptom: Router sends traffic to the wrong destination network.
topology_notes: The required remote network is 192.168.30.0/24.
known_correct_answer: Route is configured for the wrong destination network.

symptom: Router cannot reach unknown remote networks.
topology_notes: The router should have a default route through 10.0.0.2.
show_commands_output:
show ip route
C 192.168.10.0/24 is directly connected
No gateway of last resort
known_correct_answer: Default route is missing.

symptom: Remote routes exist but traffic cannot leave through the routing interface.
topology_notes: GigabitEthernet0/1 connects Router1 to Router2.
show_commands_output:
show ip interface brief
GigabitEthernet0/1 10.0.0.1 administratively down down
known_correct_answer: Routing interface is unavailable because it is administratively down.

symptom: PC can access websites by IP address but not by domain name.
topology_notes: The network DNS server is 8.8.8.8.
show_commands_output:
ipconfig /all
DNS Servers: 192.168.10.99
known_correct_answer: PC is configured with the wrong DNS server.

symptom: DNS queries fail even though network connectivity works.
topology_notes: DNS server is located at 192.168.10.53.
show_commands_output:
ping 192.168.10.53
Destination host unreachable
known_correct_answer: DNS server is unreachable.

symptom: Clients receive incorrect DNS configuration from DHCP.
topology_notes: DHCP should provide DNS server 192.168.10.53.
show_commands_output:
show running-config | section dhcp
 dns-server 192.168.20.53
known_correct_answer: DHCP provides an incorrect DNS server address.

symptom: PC has network connectivity but cannot resolve example.com.
topology_notes: DNS service should resolve domain names.
show_commands_output:
ping 8.8.8.8
Reply received
nslookup example.com
DNS request timed out
known_correct_answer: DNS name resolution is failing.

symptom: PC cannot ping the server although routing is working.
topology_notes: ICMP traffic from 192.168.10.0/24 should be permitted.
show_commands_output:
show access-lists
access-list 100 deny icmp 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 any
known_correct_answer: ACL blocks ICMP traffic.

symptom: Users cannot access the web server over HTTP.
topology_notes: HTTP traffic to the web server should be permitted.
show_commands_output:
show access-lists
access-list 101 deny tcp any host 192.168.30.10 eq 80
known_correct_answer: ACL blocks HTTP traffic.

symptom: Correct traffic is being blocked even though the ACL rules appear correct.
topology_notes: The ACL should be applied only to the WAN interface.
show_commands_output:
show ip interface GigabitEthernet0/0
Inbound access list is 101
known_correct_answer: ACL is applied to the wrong interface.

symptom: Traffic is blocked even though the ACL contains a permit rule.
topology_notes: ACL 110 should permit traffic entering the LAN interface.
show_commands_output:
show ip interface GigabitEthernet0/1
Outgoing access list is 110
known_correct_answer: ACL is applied in the wrong direction.

symptom: Internal PCs cannot access the internet using their private addresses.
topology_notes: Private LAN addresses should be translated before reaching the ISP.
show_commands_output:
show ip nat translations
Pro Inside global Inside local Outside local Outside global
No translations
known_correct_answer: NAT configuration is missing.

symptom: NAT translations are not being created.
topology_notes: GigabitEthernet0/0 is the LAN side and GigabitEthernet0/1 is the ISP side.
show_commands_output:
show ip interface
GigabitEthernet0/0
ip nat outside
GigabitEthernet0/1
ip nat inside
known_correct_answer: NAT inside and outside interfaces are reversed.

symptom: Multiple internal users cannot share the public IP address.
topology_notes: The router should use NAT overload for the internal LAN.
show_commands_output:
show running-config | include ip nat
ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/1
known_correct_answer: NAT overload is missing.

symptom: Laptop cannot find the organization's wireless network.
topology_notes: The configured wireless network name is CampusNet.
show_commands_output:
show wlan
SSID: CampusNet-Guest
known_correct_answer: Wireless SSID is incorrect.

symptom: Laptop sees the Wi-Fi network but cannot authenticate.
topology_notes: The wireless network requires WPA2-PSK.
show_commands_output:
show wlan security
Security: Open
known_correct_answer: Wireless security configuration is incorrect.

symptom: Laptop connects to Wi-Fi but cannot access devices outside its local network.
topology_notes: Wireless clients use the 192.168.50.0/24 network.
show_commands_output:
IP Address: 192.168.50.20
Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway: 192.168.60.1
known_correct_answer: Wireless client has an incorrect default gateway.

symptom: Laptop connects to the Wi-Fi SSID but does not receive an IP address.
topology_notes: Wireless clients should receive addresses from the DHCP server.
show_commands_output:
show wlan clients
Client: Laptop1
IP Address: 0.0.0.0
DHCP: Failed
known_correct_answer: Wireless DHCP assignment is failing.
